gloss: on the way, in the middle

definitions.explanation: While traveling from one place to another.
During the course of an activity or process, before completion.

examples.english: I stopped by a convenience store on the way to the station.

examples.english: I dropped my wallet during the trip.

notes:
{途中|とちゅう} indicates being partway through something (travel or activity).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途中|とちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in the middle of ~, on the way to ~
- {途中|とちゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: up to a certain point
- {途中|とちゅう}⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧: stopping off (during a journey)

EXAMPLES BY CONTEXT:
- ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途中|とちゅう}: on the way to work
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途中|とちゅう}: in the middle of talking
- {途中|とちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to quit partway through
